checks.claim_text: 84 of 91 primary model-dataset pairs are fully supported across 5 seeds (420 primary successes, 35 external LANL runs, 455 total runs).
Elliptic AP: DLG-Aug (0.1037) vs DLG-Base (0.0687), delta = +0.0350.
Reddit-Syn AP: DLG-Aug (0.3388) vs DLG-Base (0.4044), delta = -0.0656 (A11 err 0.0573/0.1229 corrected).
Blockchain comparator leaders: Ethereum OCGNN (0.4996) > Aug (0.4359); BSC AnomalyDAE (0.3609) > Aug (0.3411); Polygon AnomalyDAE (0.1878) > Aug (0.0731).
Friedman S1 (N=8, K=7): Q=29.0357, Asymptotic p=5.99e-05, 1M MC p=4.00e-06 (b=3).
Friedman S2 (N=13, K=5): Q=23.7538, Asymptotic p=8.95e-05, 1M MC p=2.10e-05 (b=20).
Friedman S3 (N=6, K=5): Q=6.1333, Asymptotic p=0.1894, 1M MC p=0.1921 (b=192107). Non-significant (p >= 0.05).
Friedman S4 (N=7, K=5): Q=21.8286, Asymptotic p=2.17e-04, 1M MC p=1.00e-06 (b=0).

Elliptic ROC-AUC values for reconstruction models fall below random baseline: DOMINANT 0.3432, AnomalyDAE 0.1296, OCGNN 0.3140, DLG-Base 0.3500; DLG-Aug is 0.5705. Label semantics and non-inversion confirmed; causal hub mechanism retained as unverified hypothesis.

abstract_snippet_approved: While Decoupled Local-to-Global augmentation (DLG-Aug) improves average precision (AP) over the DLG-Base reference on the Elliptic transaction network by +0.0350 (0.1037 vs.\ 0.0687), it suffers an AP degradation of -0.0656 on the large Reddit-Syn graph (0.3388 vs.\ 0.4044) and exhibits negative delta on LANL-RedTeam. On blockchain token-transfer networks, at least one established comparator exceeds DLG-Aug in mean AP on each of the three blockchain datasets (Ethereum: OCGNN 0.4996 vs.\ Aug 0.4359; BSC: AnomalyDAE 0.3609 vs.\ Aug 0.3411; Polygon: AnomalyDAE 0.1878 vs.\ Aug 0.0731). Furthermore, we audit the below-random ROC-AUC values (<0.50) observed on Elliptic across reconstruction baselines, confirming score and label alignment while leaving topological hub bias as an informed hypothesis rather than an uncontroverted proof.
